# statuspage_page_access_group (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage page access group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_page_access_group" "example" {
  page_id = "abc123def456"
  id      = "xyz789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `page_access_user_ids` (List of String)
